goals.description: Determine the service's supported webhook events, payload shapes, and whether its API supports automatic webhook creation and deletion.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Focus only on service webhook research. Identify event IDs/names, payload fields needed for outputs, setup requirements, and whether automatic registration endpoints exist. Do not edit files in this goal.
goals.name: Research webhook capabilities

goals.description: Inspect existing Sim triggers, registry wiring, block configuration, webhook formatting, and provider subscription patterns relevant to adding the new service trigger.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Focus only on local repository context. Read existing trigger directories, registry entries, matching block files, webhook route logic, provider cleanup logic, and alignment conventions before editing.
goals.name: Inspect local trigger patterns

goals.description: Create or update the service trigger utilities with trigger options, setup instructions, extra fields, and output builders aligned to researched events and registration mode.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Work on the service trigger utilities file only. Define all trigger options, setup instructions, service-specific extra fields, and output builders. If automatic registration is supported, include a required password API key field and automatic setup copy.
goals.name: Create trigger utilities

goals.description: Create the primary, secondary, and optional generic webhook trigger config files using buildTriggerSubBlocks, correct dropdown behavior, outputs, webhook metadata, and service icon.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Work on the individual trigger config files for the service. Use buildTriggerSubBlocks everywhere. The primary trigger must include includeDropdown: true; secondary and generic triggers must not. Keep outputs consistent with the utility builders.
goals.name: Create trigger configs

goals.description: Create or update the service trigger index barrel exports for all trigger config files.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Work only on the service trigger index.ts barrel. Export every trigger config that should be available to the registry.
goals.name: Create barrel exports

goals.description: Wire the service triggers into apps/sim/triggers/registry.ts by importing from the service barrel and adding all trigger IDs to TRIGGER_REGISTRY.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Work only on trigger registry wiring. Add the service trigger import and registry entries for every trigger ID without disturbing unrelated providers.
goals.name: Register triggers

goals.description: Enable triggers on the service block, list all available trigger IDs, and spread each trigger's subBlocks into the block subBlocks after normal tool fields.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Work only on the service block configuration. Enable triggers, add the complete trigger ID list, import/use getTrigger as needed, and spread all trigger subBlocks in the expected location.
goals.name: Connect block triggers

goals.description: If the service supports programmatic webhook management, add provider-specific webhook creation, external ID storage, rollback behavior, deletion cleanup, and cleanup dispatch wiring.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Implement this goal only if research confirmed automatic webhook creation and deletion support. Update the webhook API route for creation and rollback, and provider-subscriptions cleanup for graceful external deletion. Preserve user-friendly errors and non-fatal cleanup behavior.
goals.name: Add automatic registration

goals.description: Add a provider-specific formatWebhookInput handler only when the raw webhook payload needs transformation to match trigger outputs.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Work only on webhook input formatting. Add a provider handler if needed so returned fields exactly match trigger outputs. Avoid wrapper objects, duplicated payload shapes, and unsupported placeholder structures.
goals.name: Add input formatting

goals.description: Run alignment and TypeScript checks, and inspect the implementation against the skill checklist for trigger UI, registry, block wiring, optional automatic registration, and output formatting.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Validate the completed trigger work. Run the trigger alignment checker for the service and the repository type check where feasible. Review the checklist for dropdown behavior, registry entries, block wiring, automatic registration if applicable, and output/input alignment.
goals.name: Validate trigger implementation
